data.summary: Results-driven Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience in architecting and developing scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices. Skilled in Azure Cloud, Kubernetes, Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines. Experienced in system monitoring and observability using Prometheus and Grafana. Proven ability to lead teams, design robust APIs, modernize legacy systems, and deliver high-performance solutions. Adept at mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving technology modernization initiatives.

raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Results-driven Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience in architecting and developing scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices. Skilled in Azure Cloud, Kubernetes, Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines. Experienced in system monitoring and observability using Prometheus and Grafana. Proven ability to lead teams, design robust APIs, modernize legacy systems, and deliver high-performance solutions. Adept at mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving technology modernization initiatives.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, JPA, REST APIs, Microservices
Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure (VMs, Redis, Azure Functions, WebApps, Service Bus, Azure SQL, AKS), AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, ELB)
DevOps & Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Git, Jenkins, Maven, CI/CD
Messaging & Middleware: Kafka, IBM MQ
Databases: SQL Server, MySQL
Testing: JUnit, TestNG, Mockito
Operating Systems: Linux, Unix
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Technical Lead – Synechron – Oct 2022 – Present | Pune, India
Leading development for Alerts and Messaging System in the Wealth Management domain.
Modernized legacy systems into a Spring Boot Microservices architecture.
Implemented Kafka-based event streaming for inter-service communication.
Deployed applications on Azure AKS and integrated Azure Functions, Redis, Service Bus, and SQL.
Mentored junior developers, conducted code reviews, and designed POCs.
Senior Software Engineer – Globant – Dec 2020 – Oct 2022
Worked on E-Subrohub, an insurance subrogation platform.
Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot & JPA.
Participated in architecture design, mentoring, and code reviews.
Senior Software Engineer – Larsen & Toubro Infotech (LTI) – May 2020 – Dec 2020
Contributed to PCP-Rewrite, a healthcare insurance modernization project.
Migrated a monolithic system to Spring Boot Microservices.
Designed scalable solutions and implemented service communication strategies.
Software Engineer – JIEM India Pvt. Ltd. – Jul 2015 – Apr 2020
Developed and maintained CASEC, an English communication testing system used by Japanese students for online assessments.
Designed and implemented modules using Java 8, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, and Hibernate/JPA.
Enhanced system performance through SQL optimization, caching, and API-level improvements.
Built REST APIs for integrating with third-party systems and internal tools.
Managed AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, ELB) for application hosting and scaling.
Worked on CASEC-SF, integrating Salesforce with backend systems for reporting and invoice automation.
Used Jenkins for build automation and Maven for dependency management.
Conducted unit testing with JUnit and Mockito to ensure code quality.
Collaborated in an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, estimation, and code reviews.
Worked closely with QA and support teams to ensure reliable deployments and timely issue resolution.
raw_sections.education:
Education
Bachelor of Engineering (Computer Engineering) – Pune University | 2014 |
PG Diploma in Advanced Computing (PG-DAC) – CDAC ACTS, Pune | 2015 |
raw_sections.awards:
Achievements
Successfully led multiple cloud migration and microservices modernization projects.
Recognized for mentoring developers and improving code quality standards.
Delivered high-availability solutions on Azure and Kubernetes under strict SLAs.
